verdict.rationale: GitHub's own writing-and-formatting docs say users can 'create sophisticated formatting for your prose and code on GitHub with simple syntax,' which directly addresses the core of the story. That is the only on-topic evidence item, though, and it does not name Markdown, the surfaces involved (READMEs, issues, comments), or syntax highlighting. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the syntax is Markdown, confirmation it renders in READMEs, issues, and comments, documented syntax highlighting for code blocks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write READMEs, issues, and comments in Markdown that render with formatted prose and highlighted code

citations.quote: Create sophisticated formatting for your prose and code on GitHub with simple syntax.
